transcript: Speaker A (AI): क्या कर रही हो? [What are you doing?] Speaker B (Human): I am adding oil. Speaker A (AI): 'I am adding oil' नहीं, 'I am applying oil' या फिर 'I am oiling my hair' बोलना चाहिए। इंग्लिश सीखनी है? [Not 'I am adding oil', you should say 'I am applying oil' or 'I am oiling my hair'. Do you want to learn English?] Speaker B (Human): हाँ, हाँ, पर पैसे... [Yes, yes, but money...] Speaker A (AI): सिर्फ ₹1 हो तो काफी है। इंग्लिश सीखना शुरू कर सकते हो AI के साथ। [Just ₹1 is enough. You can start learning English with AI.] Speaker B (Human): कैसे? [How?] Speaker A (AI): English Seekho ऐप में AI टीचर के साथ डेली बात करो। वो आपको सही से बोलना सिखा देंगे। [Talk daily with an AI teacher in the English Seekho app. They will teach you how to speak correctly.] Speaker B (Human): क्या ये अच्छा होगा? [Will it be good?] Speaker A (AI): ट्यूशन और कोचिंग से भी ज्यादा इफेक्टिव होगा क्योंकि ये आपके लेवल के हिसाब से गाइड करेगा। [It will be more effective than tuition and coaching because it will guide you according to your level.] Speaker B (Human): ये सब सिर्फ ₹1 में? [All this for just ₹1?] Speaker A (AI): ट्रायल सिर्फ ₹1 का है। तो अभी English Seekho ऐप इंस्टॉल करो। [The trial is just for ₹1. So install the English Seekho app now.] Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer text in Hindi about English Seekho not being affiliated with government authorities]
summary: An AI avatar corrects a woman's English grammar in a split-screen format, promoting the English Seekho app. The ad highlights the app's AI-driven personalized learning and a 1-rupee trial offer. It concludes with a call to action to install the app.
